advisor_identified: Debra Newman Ham (also published as Debra Lynn Newman), professor of history at Morgan State University.

doctorate.title: The Emergence of Liberian Women in the Nineteenth Century

evidence.says: The National Archives introduces Dr. Debra Newman Ham as a professor of history at Morgan State University in February 2013.
The Writers Directory entry identifies Debra Newman Ham as also writing as Debra Lynn Newman and lists her as a Morgan State University professor from 1995.

Catalogue record, imported from Columbia University MARC data, gives the title The emergence of Liberian women in the nineteenth century, by Debra Lynn Newman, and states: Thesis (Ph. D.)--Howard University, 1984. OCLC 14523407.

The contributors section of the Library of Congress publication The African-American Mosaic (1993), printed page xix, states that Debra Newman Ham earned a doctorate in African history from Howard University.

notes: The catalogue uses Debra Lynn Newman, an independently documented name variant of Debra Newman Ham. Institution, year and title match linked AHA record 26544; its title abbreviates nineteenth as 19th.
